overloads.semanticRole: Expands, in place, a BLOB that was previously compressed with COMPRESS BLOB.

constraints: Sets the OK system variable to 1 if expansion succeeded, 0 otherwise.
If expansion fails due to lack of memory, no error is generated and execution continues (OK is set to 0).
If the BLOB was not previously compressed (via COMPRESS BLOB) or is damaged, error -10600 is generated, trappable with ON ERR CALL.
Use BLOB PROPERTIES to check beforehand whether a BLOB is compressed.
